summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by China Yuchai International Ltd., a foreign issuer, reporting a press release about its introduction of a high-pressure, direct-injection pure ammonia internal combustion engine for heavy-duty commercial vehicles. The filing describes a technological milestone in zero-carbon power solutions, supported by the company's R&D efforts. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change) is present. The filing is a routine operational update and product announcement.
